animation.notes: Frames are written by FiestaBoard one at a time (transition plugins step frame-by-frame); the board's own flap cascade animates each write. ~1 frame/s is the practical ceiling for legible flap motion on the local API. Cloud connections are additionally floored by FiestaBoard at one write per 15 s (transport policy, not device capability).
sources: FiestaBoard core transition runner and send floor (fiestaboard#2190)
